reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing isMonthFillCategory predicate and uses the existing extractTagsFromText parser.

duplication.why: The decision is written once; only the notes JOIN/column is repeated in the three pre-existing category queries that feed the predicate.

placement.why: The rule sits in isMonthFillCategory in server/budget/actions.ts, the single predicate every month-wide action already filters through.

scope.why: Touches only the predicate, its input type, the three feeding queries and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear single decision point; the 'fixed' literal is inline and the three near-identical SQL queries remain a pre-existing maintenance cost that the change extends.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; getBudgetData, setZero and getSpendingFillCategories all go through isMonthFillCategory

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated LEFT JOIN notes line is literal and follows the existing query duplication.

one_place.where: isMonthFillCategory in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero and all spending-fill actions
